open_finger_curls_ada5939a.name: Finger Curls
instructions: Hold a barbell with both hands and your palms facing up; hands spaced about shoulder width.
Place your feet flat on the floor, at a distance that is slightly wider than shoulder width apart. This will be your starting position.
Lower the bar as far as possible by extending the fingers. Allowing the bar to roll down the hands, catch the bar with the final joint in the fingers.
Now curl bar up as high as possible by closing your hands while exhaling. Hold the contraction at the top.
Count one controlled finger opening and closing as one repetition. Keep enough finger contact to retain the bar throughout.

Optional plate setup: hold a manageable plate by its rim at each side with palms facing inward. Let the fingers open only far enough to retain a secure hold, then close them to lift the plates. Each controlled opening and closing counts as one repetition; this is not a timed static pinch.

open_wrist_roller_3c7c9667.name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Stand with a wrist roller in both hands and the attached weight hanging at the full rope length. Raise the arms in front to a comfortable height while keeping the torso steady.
Rotate the wrists in small controlled turns to wind the rope until the weight reaches the handle.
Unwind slowly to the starting rope length. One complete wind-up and controlled unwind is one repetition.

open_seated_palm_up_barbel_87a8d029.name: Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell in an underhand grip and forearms supported on the thighs, wrists free just beyond the knees.
Curl the wrists upward while keeping the forearms still.
Lower the bar through a comfortable wrist range and repeat.
A stable bench may support the forearms instead of the thighs. Keep the wrists free beyond its edge and retain the same palms-up wrist curl.

Optional standing setup: take the bar from a reachable rack behind the body, with arms extended beside the hips and palms facing backward. Keep the forearms still while curling the wrists through a small comfortable range, then return the bar securely. The seated, forearm-supported curl remains the default.

open_seated_palms_down_bar_c6486466.name: Seated Palms-Down Barbell Wrist Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with a barbell in an overhand grip and forearms supported on the thighs, wrists free just beyond the knees.
Lift the backs of the hands while keeping the forearms still.
Lower the bar under control through a comfortable wrist range and repeat.
A stable bench may support the forearms instead of the thighs. Keep the wrists free beyond its edge and retain the same palms-down lifting of the backs of the hands.
